The local Trainer Hub is a great place to relax together with your Coromon. | ” | | | ~ **Area Description** | | **Hayville** is a town connecting [Radiant Park](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Radiant_Park "Radiant Park") and [Woodlow Forest](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Woodlow_Forest "Woodlow Forest"). It is the second town in the game, following [Lux Solis Campus](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Lux_Solis_Campus "Lux Solis Campus"). ## Contents - [1Description](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Description) - [1.1Library](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Library) - [1.2Trainer Hub](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Trainer_Hub) - [1.3Perrin's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Perrin's_House) - [1.4Al's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Al's_House) - [1.5Noah's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Noah's_House) - [1.6Mary's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Mary's_House) - [2Music Theme](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Music_Theme) - [3Layout](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Layout) - [4Coromon Located Here](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Coromon_Located_Here) - [5Encounter Rates](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Encounter_Rates) - [6Rates for fruits held during battles](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Rates_for_fruits_held_during_battles) - [7Items](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Items) - [8Shop\[1\]](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Shop[1]) - [9Quests](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Quests) - [10Hidden Gems/Items location](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Hidden_Gems/Items_location) - [11Gallery](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Gallery) ## Description Hayville is an Amish town lacking the futuristic technology present in other locations in [Velua](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Velua "Velua"), the teleporter in Noah's house being the exception. The town has farms and the fields have hay where the wild coromon reside. ### [Library](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Library "Library") [![Hayville Library.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Library.png?69b33a)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Library.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Library.png "Enlarge") A library lays in the south-west corner of town, many beginner trainers go here to read up on books all about [Coromon](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Coromon "Coromon"). The player must pay a visit to [Perrin](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Perrin "Perrin")'s brother, Merrin, to advance the story. The quests, [Monica's Study](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Monica%27s_Study "Monica's Study"), [Battle of Wits](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_of_Wits "Battle of Wits"), and [Battle of Knowledge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_of_Knowledge "Battle of Knowledge") are activated here by talking to Monica and Jebediah. ### [Trainer Hub](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Trainer_Hub "Trainer Hub") [![Hayville Map Trainer Hub.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png?7bac69)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png "Enlarge") Hayville has a trainer hub building in the form of a Coromon daycare. The [Coromon Storage](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Coromon_Storage "Coromon Storage") can not be accessed but the player's Coromon can be healed, and items can be purchased from the vending machine. ### [Perrin's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Perrin%27s_House "Perrin's House") [![Hayville Perrin House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Perrin_House.png?2f6f5e)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Perrin_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Perrin_House.png "Enlarge") Perrin's house is also his workshop where he creates Gauntlets and Spinners for [Lux Solis](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Lux_Solis "Lux Solis"). Here, he will install the Essence Collector [Module](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Module "Module") after the player saves him from an angry [Beezel](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Beezel "Beezel"). ### [Al's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Al%27s_House "Al's House") [![Hayville Al House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Al_House.png?5fd277)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Al_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Al_House.png "Enlarge") The house in the center of town next to the farm is Al's house. During the quest [Beezel Breakout](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Beezel_Breakout "Beezel Breakout"), a Beezel appears in the bedroom. During Easter, the scarecrow on his farm will wear a [Bunny Hat](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Bunny_Ears "Bunny Ears") that the player may collect. ### [Noah's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Noah%27s_House "Noah's House") [![Hayville Noah House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Hayville_Noah_House.png/320px-Hayville_Noah_House.png?158ed6)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Noah_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Noah_House.png "Enlarge") The basement of Noah's house contains a Teleporter, however it must be repaired first. When the player character first visits they'll activate the quest, [Broken Teleporter](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Broken_Teleporter "Broken Teleporter"), where Noah asks them to find the postman that got lost. ### [Mary's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Mary%27s_House "Mary's House") [![Hayville Mary House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Mary_House.png?83dbcd)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Mary_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Mary_House.png "Enlarge") The eastern-most house belongs to Mary. Two [Growing Pots](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Growing_Pots "Growing Pots") are in front. During Halloween, a pumpkin appears inside containing the [Pumpkin Hat](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Pumpkin_Hat "Pumpkin Hat"). ## Music Theme This theme plays when the player is on the town of **Hayville**, the sound of chirping birds is also heard as it is playing. _(For Mobile Users, click [here](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Town_of_Hayville_Theme.mp3 "File:Town of Hayville Theme.mp3"))_ ## Layout - The local Trainer Hub is a great place to relax together with your Coromon. | ” | | | ~ **Area Description** | | **Hayville** is a town connecting [Radiant Park](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Radiant_Park "Radiant Park") and [Woodlow Forest](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Woodlow_Forest "Woodlow Forest"). It is the second town in the game, following [Lux Solis Campus](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Lux_Solis_Campus "Lux Solis Campus"). ## Contents - [1Description](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Description) - [1.1Library](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Library) - [1.2Trainer Hub](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Trainer_Hub) - [1.3Perrin's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Perrin's_House) - [1.4Al's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Al's_House) - [1.5Noah's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Noah's_House) - [1.6Mary's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Mary's_House) - [2Music Theme](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Music_Theme) - [3Layout](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Layout) - [4Coromon Located Here](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Coromon_Located_Here) - [5Encounter Rates](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Encounter_Rates) - [6Rates for fruits held during battles](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Rates_for_fruits_held_during_battles) - [7Items](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Items) - [8Shop\[1\]](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Shop[1]) - [9Quests](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Quests) - [10Hidden Gems/Items location](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Hidden_Gems/Items_location) - [11Gallery](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Hayville#Gallery) ## Description Hayville is an Amish town lacking the futuristic technology present in other locations in [Velua](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Velua "Velua"), the teleporter in Noah's house being the exception. The town has farms and the fields have hay where the wild coromon reside. ### [Library](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Library "Library") [![Hayville Library.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Library.png?69b33a)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Library.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Library.png "Enlarge") A library lays in the south-west corner of town, many beginner trainers go here to read up on books all about [Coromon](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Coromon "Coromon"). The player must pay a visit to [Perrin](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Perrin "Perrin")'s brother, Merrin, to advance the story. The quests, [Monica's Study](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Monica%27s_Study "Monica's Study"), [Battle of Wits](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_of_Wits "Battle of Wits"), and [Battle of Knowledge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Battle_of_Knowledge "Battle of Knowledge") are activated here by talking to Monica and Jebediah. ### [Trainer Hub](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Trainer_Hub "Trainer Hub") [![Hayville Map Trainer Hub.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png?7bac69)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Map_Trainer_Hub.png "Enlarge") Hayville has a trainer hub building in the form of a Coromon daycare. The [Coromon Storage](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Coromon_Storage "Coromon Storage") can not be accessed but the player's Coromon can be healed, and items can be purchased from the vending machine. ### [Perrin's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Perrin%27s_House "Perrin's House") [![Hayville Perrin House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Perrin_House.png?2f6f5e)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Perrin_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Perrin_House.png "Enlarge") Perrin's house is also his workshop where he creates Gauntlets and Spinners for [Lux Solis](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Lux_Solis "Lux Solis"). Here, he will install the Essence Collector [Module](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Module "Module") after the player saves him from an angry [Beezel](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Beezel "Beezel"). ### [Al's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Al%27s_House "Al's House") [![Hayville Al House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Al_House.png?5fd277)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Al_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Al_House.png "Enlarge") The house in the center of town next to the farm is Al's house. During the quest [Beezel Breakout](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Beezel_Breakout "Beezel Breakout"), a Beezel appears in the bedroom. During Easter, the scarecrow on his farm will wear a [Bunny Hat](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Bunny_Ears "Bunny Ears") that the player may collect. ### [Noah's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Noah%27s_House "Noah's House") [![Hayville Noah House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/thumb/Hayville_Noah_House.png/320px-Hayville_Noah_House.png?158ed6)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Noah_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Noah_House.png "Enlarge") The basement of Noah's house contains a Teleporter, however it must be repaired first. When the player character first visits they'll activate the quest, [Broken Teleporter](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Broken_Teleporter "Broken Teleporter"), where Noah asks them to find the postman that got lost. ### [Mary's House](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Mary%27s_House "Mary's House") [![Hayville Mary House.png](https://coromon.wiki.gg/images/Hayville_Mary_House.png?83dbcd)](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Mary_House.png) [Enlarge](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Hayville_Mary_House.png "Enlarge") The eastern-most house belongs to Mary. Two [Growing Pots](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Growing_Pots "Growing Pots") are in front. During Halloween, a pumpkin appears inside containing the [Pumpkin Hat](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/Pumpkin_Hat "Pumpkin Hat"). ## Music Theme This theme plays when the player is on the town of **Hayville**, the sound of chirping birds is also heard as it is playing. _(For Mobile Users, click [here](https://coromon.wiki.gg/wiki/File:Town_of_Hayville_Theme.mp3 "File:Town of Hayville Theme.mp3"))_ ## Layout -   "markdown": "# Cassette Beasts (2023)

**Adventure. Battle. Transform.**

**Collect awesome monster forms** to use during turn-based battles in this indie open-world RPG. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ [Fusion System](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/fusion/) to create unique and powerful new ones!

**Welcome to New Wirral**, a remote island inhabited by creatures you’ve only dreamed of, nightmares you _hopefully_ haven’t, and a cast of brave folks who use cassette tapes to transform for battle. To find a way home you’ll need to explore every inch of the island, and record monsters to tape to gain their abilities!

Cassette Beasts \| PC release Trailer \| Available on Consoles May 25th! - YouTube

Tap to unmute

[Cassette Beasts \| PC release Trailer \| Available on Consoles May 25th!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_OLST_Fw5Ms) [Raw Fury](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbyFV2lioP9a1YlUC4gm6xA)

![thumbnail-image](https://yt3.ggpht.com/9uqVN6IW6OQhks4jsoA_C88aiHAV2tfukxVG4qjUurxNX4mgTRkqKFD4zzkjYLF5GtNRxcFE=s68-c-k-c0x00ffffff-no-rj)

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/site_screenshot_3-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/site_screenshot_3.png)“Put the tape in and listen to it… Don’t ask me how it works, it just does.”

#### Transform into monsters using… retro cassette tapes?!

Faced with the constant threat of monster attacks, the residents of Harbourtown, New Wirral choose to fight fire with fire. Record a monster to tape, then play it back to take on its form for battle!

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/fusions_button.png)“There is a way… a way for us to combine our strengths and win this!”

#### Fuse monster forms

Getting close to your companion has benefits–while transformed you can combine your strengths to gain the upper hand in battle! Any two monster forms can be fused to produce unique, fully-animated new [fusion](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/fusion/) forms.

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_06-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_06.png)“Okay, don’t freak out–but you’re in a different world now.”

#### Explore a rich open world

Certain monster abilities can be used in human form. You’ll need these to help you get around, solve puzzles, and locate dungeons. Glide, fly, swim, climb, dash, or turn magnetic!

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_07-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_07.png)“It’s us, out here, surrounded by monsters. To be honest, we need all the help we can get.”

#### Travel alongside a diverse cast of human companions

Never fight alone! Form bonds, spend time together, and help your selected partner complete personal goals to become a better team. The strength of your relationship determines how well you’re able to fuse!

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/chemistry-1-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/chemistry-1.png)

#### Master a deep battle system

Take advantage of [elemental chemistry](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/chemistry/) to apply extra buffs or debuffs alongside your attack, or even alter your opponent’s elemental type!

🌟 Available now on Steam,Xbox One, Xbox Series X\|S, Xbox Game Pass and Nintendo Switch! 🌟

Purchase Cassette Beasts on Steam, and leave us a review to support us!

# About Us

[Bytten Studio](https://bytten-studio.com/) is an indie team based in Brighton UK, co-founded by [Jay Baylis](https://twitter.com/samuriferret) and [Tom Coxon](https://twitter.com/tccoxon).

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/jay-300x300.png)

**Jay Baylis** Artist, Writer & Designer

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/tom-300x300.png)

**Tom Coxon**

Programmer & Designer

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/joel-300x300.png)

**Joel Baylis**

Composer

We have over a decade and a half of combined experience working on successful pixel art indie games. Our first release as a studio, [Lenna’s Inception](https://lennasinception.com/), was a procedurally-generated action-adventure RPG, with a branching narrative and two complete art styles. It released on PC platforms in January 2020.

![](https://lennasinception.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Lennas-Inception-Logo.png)

Other games we’ve worked on include:

- **[Stardew Valley](https://stardewvalley.net/)**: a farming sim released in 2016 to huge critical and commercial success. It has sold over 10 million copies and been ported to all major platforms.
- **Starbound**: a multiplayer sandbox adventure game that developed a large following across its development from crowd-funding, early access and through to release.
- **Wargroove**: a turn-based strategy game inspired by Nintendo’s Advance Wars series, which was a major success despite its niche genre.

Cassette Beasts is a dream game for us. We can’t wait to share it with you all! 🙂

Getting close to your companion has benefits–while transformed you can combine your strengths to gain the upper hand in battle! Any two monster forms can be fused to produce unique, fully-animated new [fusion](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/fusion/) forms.

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_06-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_06.png)“Okay, don’t freak out–but you’re in a different world now.”

#### Explore a rich open world

Certain monster abilities can be used in human form. You’ll need these to help you get around, solve puzzles, and locate dungeons. Glide, fly, swim, climb, dash, or turn magnetic!

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_07-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/new_screenshot_07.png)“It’s us, out here, surrounded by monsters. To be honest, we need all the help we can get.”

#### Travel alongside a diverse cast of human companions

Never fight alone! Form bonds, spend time together, and help your selected partner complete personal goals to become a better team. The strength of your relationship determines how well you’re able to fuse!

[![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/chemistry-1-1024x576.png)](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/chemistry-1.png)

#### Master a deep battle system

Take advantage of [elemental chemistry](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/chemistry/) to apply extra buffs or debuffs alongside your attack, or even alter your opponent’s elemental type!

🌟 Available now on Steam,Xbox One, Xbox Series X\|S, Xbox Game Pass and Nintendo Switch! 🌟

Purchase Cassette Beasts on Steam, and leave us a review to support us!

# About Us

[Bytten Studio](https://bytten-studio.com/) is an indie team based in Brighton UK, co-founded by [Jay Baylis](https://twitter.com/samuriferret) and [Tom Coxon](https://twitter.com/tccoxon).

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/jay-300x300.png)

**Jay Baylis** Artist, Writer & Designer

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/tom-300x300.png)

**Tom Coxon**

Programmer & Designer

![](https://www.cassettebeasts.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/joel-300x300.png)

**Joel Baylis**

Composer

We have over a decade and a half of combined experience working on successful pixel art indie games. Our first release as a studio, [Lenna’s Inception](https://lennasinception.com/), was a procedurally-generated action-adventure RPG, with a branching narrative and two complete art styles. It released on PC platforms in January 2020.

![](https://lennasinception.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Lennas-Inception-Logo.png)

Other games we’ve worked on include:

- **[Stardew Valley](https://stardewvalley.net/)**: a farming sim released in 2016 to huge critical and commercial success. It has sold over 10 million copies and been ported to all major platforms.
- **Starbound**: a multiplayer sandbox adventure game that developed a large following across its development from crowd-funding, early access and through to release.
- **Wargroove**: a turn-based strategy game inspired by Nintendo’s Advance Wars series, which was a major success despite its niche genre.

Cassette Beasts is a dream game for us. We can’t wait to share it with you all! 🙂
